usage.summary:
Gate passed on run 2 of 4: 193 model states and 384 conformance transitions checked, both witnesses reached, and both known bugs caught.

Added `conformance.ts` with seeded real-request execution and resets between decisions. `proxy.ts`, the model, and all ratified definitions remain unchanged.

pins.name: Spec
pins.says: The guard starts ready, decides one request, and returns to ready before deciding another.

pins.name: TypeOK
pins.says: The state is ready with no request, or holds one bounded request and its NextResponse.next() or HTTP 403 result.

pins.name: SafeMethodsPass
pins.says: GET, HEAD and OPTIONS pass regardless of their headers.

pins.name: UntrustedHostsRefused
pins.says: Every other method receives 403 unless Host names a local address or a hostname in ASK3D_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

pins.name: CrossSiteRefused
pins.says: Every other method receives 403 when a nonempty Sec-Fetch-Site is neither same-origin nor none.

pins.name: MismatchedOriginRefused
pins.says: Every other method receives 403 when a valid nonempty Origin has a URL host that differs from the raw Host header, including case and port.

pins.name: MalformedOriginRefused
pins.says: Every other method receives 403 when a nonempty Origin cannot be parsed as a URL.

pins.name: AcceptedRequestsPass
pins.says: A request passes when its Host is local or listed, Sec-Fetch-Site is absent, empty, same-origin or none, and Origin is absent, empty or has exactly the same URL host as Host.

pins.name: LocalCurlPasses
pins.says: A POST to localhost:3000 with neither browser header can pass.

pins.name: RebindingRefused
pins.says: A POST to evil.example:3000 can receive 403 even with same-origin Sec-Fetch-Site and its own Origin.

pins.name: SkipHostCheck
pins.says: A faulty guard passes a request from an untrusted Host because its browser headers are acceptable.

pins.name: IgnoreCrossSite
pins.says: A faulty guard passes a cross-site request to an allowed Host because its Origin matches.

usage.summary:
I found two problems.

- [conformance.ts:165](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-review-2528396722/conformance.ts:165): Action selection depends on `exchange`, forcing alternating `Decide` and `Reset`. It never tries `Decide` with an outstanding response or `Reset` while ready. These restrictions mirror model guards, not environment bounds, so the driver can conceal forbidden transitions. Both actions must be selectable independently of state.
- [conformance.ts:13](/var/folders/fz/s3p17rl97r30y73d180fjbmc0000gn/T/invariant-review-2528396722/conformance.ts:13): `../../proxy.ts` points outside this project, whereas the manifest identifies project-root `proxy.ts`. The driver therefore targets a different location or fails to load, undermining evidence about the declared implementation.

The declared `proxy.ts` was absent, so I could not verify implementation behavior or numeric parameters. Nothing was changed.

review.text:
I found two problems.

- [conformance.ts:165](conformance.ts:165): Action selection depends on `exchange`, forcing alternating `Decide` and `Reset`. It never tries `Decide` with an outstanding response or `Reset` while ready. These restrictions mirror model guards, not environment bounds, so the driver can conceal forbidden transitions. Both actions must be selectable independently of state.
- [conformance.ts:13](conformance.ts:13): `../../proxy.ts` points outside this project, whereas the manifest identifies project-root `proxy.ts`. The driver therefore targets a different location or fails to load, undermining evidence about the declared implementation.

The declared `proxy.ts` was absent, so I could not verify implementation behavior or numeric parameters. Nothing was changed.
